sentences.chinese: 杂草已经很熟悉地下大厅。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yǐ jīng hěn shú xī dì xià dà tīng 。
sentences.english: Weed already knows the underground hall well.

sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ hěn àn 。
sentences.english: It is very dark there.

sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ yě hěn wēi xiǎn 。
sentences.english: It is dangerous there too.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo bù zháo jí 。
sentences.english: But Weed does not hurry.

sentences.pinyin: tā yì tiáo lù yì tiáo lù dì zǒu 。
sentences.english: He walks path by path.

sentences.pinyin: tā jì zhù měi yí gè zhuǎn jiǎo 。
sentences.english: He remembers every corner.

sentences.chinese: 他也记住怪物出现的地方。
sentences.pinyin: tā yě jì zhù guài wù chū xiàn de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: He also remembers where monsters appear.

sentences.chinese: 一个人打怪，最怕突然被围住。
sentences.pinyin: yí gè rén dǎ guài ， zuì pà tū rán bèi wéi zhù 。
sentences.english: When fighting alone, the scariest thing is suddenly being surrounded.

sentences.chinese: 所以他准备了休息的地方。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā zhǔn bèi le xiū xi de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: So he prepares places to rest.

sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ yǒu bēng dài 。
sentences.english: There are bandages there.

sentences.pinyin: nà lǐ yě yǒu cǎo yào 。
sentences.english: There are herbs there too.

sentences.chinese: 累了的时候，他就躲进去。
sentences.pinyin: lèi le de shí hòu ， tā jiù duǒ jìn qù 。
sentences.english: When he is tired, he hides inside.

sentences.chinese: 受伤的时候，他也躲进去。
sentences.pinyin: shòu shāng de shí hòu ， tā yě duǒ jìn qù 。
sentences.english: When he is hurt, he hides inside too.

sentences.chinese: 慢慢地，地下大厅变得清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: màn màn dì ， dì xià dà tīng biàn de qīng chǔ le 。
sentences.english: Slowly, the underground hall becomes clear.

sentences.pinyin: bú shì yīn wèi tā ān quán 。
sentences.english: Not because it is safe.

sentences.pinyin: ér shì yīn wèi zá cǎo tài xiǎo xīn 。
sentences.english: But because Weed is so careful.

sentences.chinese: 最后，他走完了最后一块地方。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu ， tā zǒu wán le zuì hòu yí kuài dì fāng 。
sentences.english: At last, he finishes the final area.

sentences.pinyin: xì tǒng de shēng yīn xiǎng qǐ lái 。
sentences.english: The system sound rings out.

sentences.pinyin: tā wán chéng le dì xià dì tú 。
sentences.english: He has completed the underground map.

sentences.pinyin: míng shēng zēng jiā le 。
sentences.english: His fame increases.

sentences.chinese: 更重要的是，地图可以卖钱。
sentences.pinyin: gèng zhòng yào de shì ， dì tú kě yǐ mài qián 。
sentences.english: More importantly, the map can be sold for money.

sentences.chinese: 杂草听到这里，心里安静了。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng dào zhè lǐ ， xīn lǐ ān jìng le 。
sentences.english: When Weed hears this, his heart becomes calm.

sentences.pinyin: wēi xiǎn kě yǐ rěn 。
sentences.english: Danger can be endured.

sentences.pinyin: xīn kǔ yě kě yǐ rěn 。
sentences.english: Hard work can be endured too.

sentences.chinese: 可是能卖钱的地图，不能错过。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì néng mài qián de dì tú ， bù néng cuò guò 。
sentences.english: But a map that can be sold for money cannot be missed.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo lí kāi dì xià dà tīng 。
sentences.english: Weed leaves the underground hall.

sentences.pinyin: tā zǒu xiàng lìng yí gè dòng xué 。
sentences.english: He walks toward another cave.

sentences.chinese: 这个洞穴叫死去战士的洞穴。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dòng xué jiào sǐ qù zhàn shì de dòng xué 。
sentences.english: This cave is called the Cave of Dead Warriors.

sentences.pinyin: míng zì jiù bù hǎo tīng 。
sentences.english: Even the name does not sound good.

sentences.pinyin: lǐ miàn chuán lái dī dī de shēng yīn 。
sentences.english: A low sound comes from inside.

sentences.pinyin: fēng yě hěn lěng 。
sentences.english: The wind is cold too.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo wò zhù jiàn 。
sentences.english: Weed holds his sword.

sentences.pinyin: tā yí bù yi bù wǎng qián zǒu 。
sentences.english: He walks forward step by step.

sentences.chinese: 很快，一个怪物挡住了路。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài ， yí gè guài wù dǎng zhù le lù 。
sentences.english: Soon, a monster blocks the path.

sentences.pinyin: nà shì yí gè gāo dà de qí shì 。
sentences.english: It is a tall knight.

sentences.chinese: 可是他的头不在脖子上。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā de tóu bú zài bó zi shàng 。
sentences.english: But his head is not on his neck.

sentences.pinyin: tā de tóu ， bèi tā ná zài shǒu lǐ 。
sentences.english: His head is held in his hand.

sentences.pinyin: nà ge tóu kāi kǒu shuō huà 。
sentences.english: That head begins to speak.

sentences.pinyin: nǐ shì qí shì ma ？
sentences.english: Are you a knight?

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo lěng jìng dì huí dá 。
sentences.english: Weed answers calmly.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ bú shì qí shì 。
sentences.english: I am not a knight.

sentences.pinyin: guài wù hěn shī wàng 。
sentences.english: The monster is disappointed.

sentences.chinese: 它想和强大的骑士战斗。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng hé qiáng dà de qí shì zhàn dòu 。
sentences.english: It wants to fight a strong knight.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo què zhī xiǎng huó xià lái 。
sentences.english: But Weed only wants to survive.

sentences.pinyin: tā kàn zhe guài wù de dòng zuò 。
sentences.english: He watches the monster's movements.

sentences.pinyin: tā kàn zhuó shǒu lǐ de tóu 。
sentences.english: He watches the head in its hand.

sentences.pinyin: zhè ge dí rén hěn qiáng 。
sentences.english: This enemy is strong.

sentences.pinyin: dàn shì qiáng dí yě yǒu xí guàn 。
sentences.english: But strong enemies also have habits.

sentences.chinese: 杂草等待那个习惯出现。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo děng dài nà ge xí guàn chū xiàn 。
sentences.english: Weed waits for that habit to appear.

sentences.pinyin: rán hòu ， tā jǔ qǐ le jiàn 。
sentences.english: Then, he raises his sword.

sentences.chinese: 在洞穴里，杂草遇见了一个人。
sentences.pinyin: zài dòng xué lǐ ， zá cǎo yù jiàn le yí gè rén 。
sentences.english: In the cave, Weed meets someone.

sentences.pinyin: tā de míng zì jiào dài ēn 。
sentences.english: Her name is Da'in.

sentences.pinyin: tā bú shì pǔ tōng wán jiā 。
sentences.english: She is not an ordinary player.

sentences.pinyin: tā huì zhì liáo 。
sentences.english: She can heal.

sentences.pinyin: tā yě huì gěi rén zhù fú 。
sentences.english: She can also bless people.

sentences.pinyin: zhù fú luò zài zá cǎo shēn shàng 。
sentences.english: The blessing falls on Weed.

sentences.pinyin: tā de shēn tǐ biàn qīng le 。
sentences.english: His body becomes lighter.

sentences.pinyin: tā de jiàn yě gèng kuài le 。
sentences.english: His sword becomes faster too.

sentences.pinyin: guài wù bèi xuē ruò 。
sentences.english: The monsters are weakened.

sentences.pinyin: zhàn dòu tū rán biàn de shùn lì 。
sentences.english: The fight suddenly becomes smoother.

sentences.chinese: 可是杂草没有完全放心。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zá cǎo méi yǒu wán quán fàng xīn 。
sentences.english: But Weed does not fully relax.

sentences.pinyin: tā gāng gāng rèn shi tā 。
sentences.english: He has only just met her.

sentences.chinese: 在危险的地方，信任很贵。
sentences.pinyin: zài wēi xiǎn de dì fāng ， xìn rèn hěn guì 。
sentences.english: In a dangerous place, trust is costly.

sentences.chinese: 戴恩说，她知道一些地下城。
sentences.pinyin: dài ēn shuō ， tā zhī dào yì xiē dì xià chéng 。
sentences.english: Da'in says she knows some dungeons.

sentences.chinese: 那些地方还没有人进去。
sentences.pinyin: nà xiē dì fāng hái méi yǒu rén jìn qù 。
sentences.english: No one has entered those places yet.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tīng le ， gèng jiā huái yí 。
sentences.english: When Weed hears this, he becomes even more suspicious.

sentences.chinese: 未发现的地下城，代表名声。
sentences.pinyin: wèi fā xiàn de dì xià chéng ， dài biǎo míng shēng 。
sentences.english: Undiscovered dungeons mean fame.

sentences.pinyin: yě dài biǎo jiǎng lì 。
sentences.english: They also mean rewards.

sentences.pinyin: zěn me huì yǒu rén bú jìn qù ？
sentences.english: How could someone not go in?

sentences.pinyin: dài ēn méi yǒu shuō quán bù yuán yīn 。
sentences.english: Da'in does not give the whole reason.

sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì qǐng tā xiāng xìn tā 。
sentences.english: She only asks him to trust her.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo chén mò le yí huì er 。
sentences.english: Weed is silent for a while.

sentences.pinyin: tā bù néng wán quán xiāng xìn 。
sentences.english: He cannot fully trust her.

sentences.pinyin: dàn xiàn zài ， tā hěn yǒu yòng 。
sentences.english: But right now, she is useful.

sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā men jì xù wǎng qián zǒu 。
sentences.english: So they continue walking forward.

sentences.chinese: 战斗结束以后，洞穴安静下来。
sentences.pinyin: zhàn dòu jié shù yǐ hòu ， dòng xué ān jìng xià lái 。
sentences.english: After the fight ends, the cave becomes quiet.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo shōu hǎo diào luò de dōng xī 。
sentences.english: Weed puts away the dropped items.

sentences.pinyin: yí jiàn yě bù néng làng fèi 。
sentences.english: Not one thing can be wasted.

sentences.pinyin: dài ēn zài páng biān kàn zhe tā 。
sentences.english: Da'in watches him from the side.

sentences.pinyin: tā jué de zhè ge rén hěn qí guài 。
sentences.english: She thinks this person is strange.

sentences.pinyin: tā zhàn dòu de shí hòu hěn lěng 。
sentences.english: When he fights, he is cold.

sentences.chinese: 可是看到材料的时候，眼睛会亮。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì kàn dào cái liào de shí hòu ， yǎn jīng huì liàng 。
sentences.english: But when he sees materials, his eyes brighten.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo ná chū guō 。
sentences.english: Weed takes out a pot.

sentences.pinyin: tā kāi shǐ zuò fàn 。
sentences.english: He starts cooking.

sentences.pinyin: dòng xué lǐ yǒu rè qì 。
sentences.english: There is warm steam in the cave.

sentences.pinyin: xiāng wèi màn màn sàn kāi 。
sentences.english: The smell slowly spreads out.

sentences.pinyin: dài ēn de biǎo qíng biàn ruǎn le 。
sentences.english: Da'in's expression softens.

sentences.chinese: 她已经很久没有这样吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng hěn jiǔ méi yǒu zhè yàng chī fàn 。
sentences.english: She has not eaten like this in a long time.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo bǎ shí wù fēn gěi tā 。
sentences.english: Weed shares the food with her.

sentences.pinyin: tā méi yǒu shuō wēn róu de huà 。
sentences.english: He does not say gentle words.

sentences.chinese: 可是热食物本身，就很温柔。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì rè shí wù běn shēn ， jiù hěn wēn róu 。
sentences.english: But the warm food itself is gentle.

sentences.pinyin: liǎng gè rén ān jìng dì chī 。
sentences.english: The two of them eat quietly.

sentences.pinyin: wài miàn hái yǒu wēi xiǎn 。
sentences.english: There is still danger outside.

sentences.pinyin: lǐ miàn yě bù ān quán 。
sentences.english: It is not safe inside either.

sentences.chinese: 但是这一小会儿，可以休息。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè yì xiǎo huì er ， kě yǐ xiū xi 。
sentences.english: But for this little while, they can rest.

sentences.pinyin: dài ēn qīng qīng xiào le 。
sentences.english: Da'in smiles softly.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn le yì yǎn 。
sentences.english: Weed glances at her.

sentences.chinese: 他还是没有完全相信她。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái shì méi yǒu wán quán xiāng xìn tā 。
sentences.english: He still does not fully trust her.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì tā zhī dào yí jiàn shì 。
sentences.english: But he knows one thing.

sentences.chinese: 一起吃饭的人，暂时不会太远。
sentences.pinyin: yì qǐ chī fàn de rén ， zàn shí bú huì tài yuǎn 。
sentences.english: People who eat together are, for now, not too distant.

sentences.chinese: 拉维亚斯的街上，有很多雕像。
sentences.pinyin: lā wéi yà sī de jiē shàng ， yǒu hěn duō diāo xiàng 。
sentences.english: On the streets of Lavias, there are many statues.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu de zài qiáng biān 。
sentences.english: Some are beside walls.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu de zài xiǎo lù páng 。
sentences.english: Some are beside small paths.

sentences.pinyin: yǒu de yǐ jīng hěn jiù 。
sentences.english: Some are already very old.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì měi yí gè dōu yǒu gǎn jué 。
sentences.english: But each one has feeling.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo tíng xià lái 。
sentences.english: Weed stops.

sentences.chinese: 他看着一个没有名字的雕像。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn zhe yí gè méi yǒu míng zì de diāo xiàng 。
sentences.english: He looks at a nameless statue.

sentences.pinyin: diāo xiàng bú shì hěn huá lì 。
sentences.english: The statue is not very splendid.

sentences.pinyin: xiàn tiáo yě bú fù zá 。
sentences.english: The lines are not complicated either.

sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā hěn ān jìng 。
sentences.english: But it is very quiet.

sentences.pinyin: xiàng shì zài děng rén 。
sentences.english: It is as if it is waiting for someone.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo shēn chū shǒu 。
sentences.english: Weed reaches out his hand.

sentences.chinese: 他的手指碰到冰冷的石头。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shǒu zhǐ pèng dào bīng lěng de shí tou 。
sentences.english: His fingers touch the cold stone.

sentences.pinyin: xì tǒng de shēng yīn zài cì xiǎng qǐ 。
sentences.english: The system sound rings out again.

sentences.chinese: 他理解了雕刻的一点意义。
sentences.pinyin: tā lǐ jiě le diāo kè de yì diǎn yì yì 。
sentences.english: He understands a small meaning of sculpture.

sentences.chinese: 不是所有作品都要有大名字。
sentences.pinyin: bú shì suǒ yǒu zuò pǐn dōu yào yǒu dà míng zì 。
sentences.english: Not every work needs a great name.

sentences.chinese: 有些作品，只是留下心情。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē zuò pǐn ， zhǐ shì liú xià xīn qíng 。
sentences.english: Some works only leave behind a feeling.

sentences.chinese: 有些作品，只是陪着城市。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē zuò pǐn ， zhǐ shì péi zhe chéng shì 。
sentences.english: Some works only keep a city company.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn le hěn jiǔ 。
sentences.english: Weed looks for a long time.

sentences.pinyin: tā méi yǒu mǎ shàng lí kāi 。
sentences.english: He does not leave right away.

sentences.chinese: 他是为了任务来到这里。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì wèi le rèn wu lái dào zhè lǐ 。
sentences.english: He came here for a quest.

sentences.pinyin: yě shì wèi le qián lái dào zhè lǐ 。
sentences.english: He also came here for money.

sentences.chinese: 可是这一刻，他想起自己是雕刻家。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì zhè yí kè ， tā xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ shì diāo kè jiā 。
sentences.english: But in this moment, he remembers that he is a sculptor.

sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shēn fèn hěn má fán 。
sentences.english: This identity is troublesome.

sentences.chinese: 但它也让他看见别人看不见的东西。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā yě ràng tā kàn jiàn bié rén kàn bú jiàn de dōng xī 。
sentences.english: But it also lets him see things others cannot see.

sentences.chinese: 杂草在拉维亚斯继续寻找线索。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo zài lā wéi yà sī jì xù xún zhǎo xiàn suǒ 。
sentences.english: Weed continues looking for clues in Lavias.

sentences.chinese: 这一次，线索和神殿有关。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì ， xiàn suǒ hé shén diàn yǒu guān 。
sentences.english: This time, the clue is connected to a temple.

sentences.pinyin: shén diàn de rèn wu tōng cháng hěn nán 。
sentences.english: Temple quests are usually difficult.

sentences.pinyin: kě shì jiǎng lì yě hěn dà 。
sentences.english: But the rewards are also great.

sentences.chinese: 杂草一听到奖励，精神就好了。
sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo yì tīng dào jiǎng lì ， jīng shén jiù hǎo le 。
sentences.english: As soon as Weed hears reward, his spirit improves.

sentences.chinese: 任务说，有一件宝物被夺走。
sentences.pinyin: rèn wu shuō ， yǒu yí jiàn bǎo wù bèi duó zǒu 。
sentences.english: The quest says a treasure has been taken.

sentences.chinese: 那是芙蕾雅神殿的圣物。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì fú lěi yǎ shén diàn de shèng wù 。
sentences.english: It is a holy item of Freya's temple.

sentences.chinese: 它可能被藏在危险的地方。
sentences.pinyin: tā kě néng bèi cáng zài wēi xiǎn de dì fāng 。
sentences.english: It may be hidden in a dangerous place.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo kàn zhe rèn wu nèi róng 。
sentences.english: Weed looks at the quest details.

sentences.pinyin: tā méi yǒu mǎ shàng xiào 。
sentences.english: He does not smile right away.

sentences.pinyin: wēi xiǎn shì zhēn de 。
sentences.english: The danger is real.

sentences.pinyin: dí rén yě yí dìng hěn qiáng 。
sentences.english: The enemies must be strong too.

sentences.chinese: 但是这条任务线，很可能有后续。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè tiáo rèn wu xiàn ， hěn kě néng yǒu hòu xù 。
sentences.english: But this quest line probably has more after it.

sentences.pinyin: hòu xù ， dài biǎo gèng duō jiǎng lì 。
sentences.english: More after it means more rewards.

sentences.pinyin: zá cǎo xīn lǐ hěn qīng chǔ 。
sentences.english: Weed understands this clearly.

sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài bù néng tuì 。
sentences.english: He cannot retreat now.

sentences.pinyin: tā jiǎn chá zhuāng bèi 。
sentences.english: He checks his equipment.

sentences.pinyin: tā jiǎn chá yào shuǐ 。
sentences.english: He checks his potions.

sentences.chinese: 他也检查可以卖掉的东西。
